```python
from fractions import Fraction

budget = Fraction(1000)
reduction = Fraction(25, 100)
reduced_price = Fraction(50)

original_price = reduced_price / (1 - reduction)
original_quantity = budget / original_price
reduced_quantity = budget / reduced_price
extra_quantity = reduced_quantity - original_quantity
submitted_answer = Fraction(20)

print("Original price (Rs/kg):", original_price)
print("Quantity before reduction (kg):", original_quantity)
print("Quantity after reduction (kg):", reduced_quantity)
print("Additional quantity (kg):", extra_quantity)
print("Submitted answer (kg):", submitted_answer)
print("CHECK PASS" if submitted_answer == extra_quantity else "CHECK FAIL")
```
